title: Common schema
description: Schema for information used by several schemas.

$schema.description: URI reference to the schema that documents this file.

language.description: BCP-47 language code used in the localization of this file.

comments.description: Comments about the automatic generation of this file.

formLayout.description: Layout definition describing header fields and sectioned columns, or a list of tabs.

header.description: List of field names to render in the header row.

items.description: Field name to render in the header row.

sections.description: Array of sections that compose the form body.

items.description: A single section with title, state and columns.

columns.description: Columns for this section; each column is an array of field names or row arrays.

items.description: A single column containing field names or row arrays.
Field names or rows of field names.

oneOf.description: Field name used in this column.
Row of field names rendered side by side.

tabs.description: Array of tabs, each containing a label and either sections/header or a listView.

label.description: Tab label displayed in the tab bar.

textColor.description: Optional text color for the tab label.

icon.description: Optional name of icon to display in the tab.

iconColor.description: Optional color for the tab icon.

header.description: List of field names to render in the header row of this tab.

items.description: Field name to render in the header row.

sections.description: Array of sections for this tab.

listView.description: Embedded listView to display in this tab.

toolbarItem.description: A single toolbar item. May be a string (logical name) or an object defining the item.

selectedTip.description: Tooltip text when toggle is selected.

toggle.description: Whether this is a toggle button.

action.description: Named action to invoke on click.

menuItem.description: A menu item in a dropdown.

type.description: Menu item type (optional, used for separators).

name.description: Logical name for the menu item.

action.description: Named action to invoke on click.

language.description: Locale code used in this file (e.g. 'ptBR', 'enUS').

header.description: Whether to show the table header.

footer.description: Whether to show the table footer.

idAccessor.description: Path to the unique identifier field in each record.

nameAccessor.description: Path to the display name field in each record.

rowClassAccessor.description: Path to a field used to determine row CSS class.

columns.description: List of column names to display (references fields).

items.description: Field name to display as a column.

actions.description: List of record actions available (e.g. record_detail, record_edit, record_delete).

toolbar.description: Toolbar items for the filter panel.

field.description: Unified field definition for both listview columns and form fields.

accessor.description: Dot-notation path to the value in the record (e.g. 'empresa.nome').

options.description: Reference to an options table for select fields.

multiple.description: Whether a select field accepts multiple values (array).

colWidth.description: Column width in pixels or percentage.

colStyles.description: Style keyword or list of style keywords for the column cells.

emphasizeColumn.description: Whether to visually emphasize this column with special styling.

icon.description: Icon name to show in the column header next to the title.

iconColor.description: Color of the icon in the column header. Can be a CSS color or design system variable.

footer.description: Column footer text template. Supports macros: {count}, {unique}, {sum}.

footerIcon.description: Icon name to show in the column footer cell instead of text.

header.description: Column header text template. Supports macros: {count}, {unique}, {sum}.

headerIcon.description: Icon name to show in the column header cell next to the title.

render.description: Custom rendering configuration for the column.

wrapperWidth.description: Width of the form field wrapper (badge) for colorWrapper render layout.

label.description: Label text displayed above the input field.

fieldWidth.description: Width of the form field. Can be a number (pixels) or percentage string.

filterWidth.description: Width of the filter field. Can be a number (pixels) or percentage string. If not given, 'fieldWidth' is used.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when the field is empty.

filterPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for filter inputs. If not given, 'placeholder' is used.

defaultValue.description: Default field value for new records.

required.description: Whether the field is required for form submission.

readOnly.description: Whether the field is read-only (not editable).

enabled.description: Whether the field is enabled. Defaults to true.

fieldRender.description: Custom rendering configuration for a column.

tab.description: Tab name to append when using the 'iconWithBadge' layout.

fieldRenderValue.description: A value entry for stacked column rendering.

accessor.description: Dot-notation path to the value in the record.

styles.description: CSS class names or style keywords (e.g. 'bold', 'italic', 'small').

mask.description: Mask configuration for formatting this stacked value.

optionsRef.description: Reference to an options table for populating select fields.

table.description: Name of the data table containing the options.

valueAccessor.description: Dot-notation path to the value field. Defaults to 'value'.

labelAccessor.description: Dot-notation path to the label field. Defaults to 'label'.

filter.description: Optional field name used to filter options. Only options whose row[filter] matches record[filter] will be shown.

mask.description: Mask configuration for formatting string values.

pattern.description: Mask pattern where '0' represents a digit (e.g. '0000' or '0.00-0').

digits.description: Total number of digits expected in the value.
